audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.early is the identical template shared with every matchup and never mentions that Grasping Roots grounds Rell's dash specifically, rather than just rooting movement in general.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/zyra.json flags BOTH Deadly Spines (Q) and Grasping Roots (E) as 'grounding' — 'shuts off enemy dashes'. audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.early, tradeGood/tradeBad and the level-3 chart why to name grounding explicitly.
